messages.subject: פונקציה שימושית למציאת עזרה
parts:
I admit I haven't finished reading the latest R newspaper (any volunteers for a digest in Hebrew?)  but I felt I had to share the function findFn( ) in the sos package.
This function searches CRAN and returns results as an R object which alows printing or exporting as HTML or XLS.
A great to discover new functions and data sets.
